## ⚠️ STOP — read this first

**Do not report security vulnerabilities here.**

If your report involves any of the following, **do not open a public Issue**:

- a credential or secret leaking into memory, logs or a model request
- a way to bypass the secret gate, sensitive approval or identity protection
- unauthorized data egress
- any exploitable weakness

Those belong in a **private** report. See [`SECURITY.md`](../../SECURITY.md)
for the contact channel.

---

## What IS appropriate here

- A documentation gap about privacy behaviour
- A question about what data is stored or sent
- A hardening suggestion with no exploitable detail
- A false positive in the secret scanner
